title: Library Management System
overview: A terminal based library management system built with Java.
description: A pure Java backend app emphasizing OOP principles, encapsulation, and Java Collections to handle CRUD database logic.
features: Dynamic CRUD operations for books and borrowers data profiles
Query searching mechanisms to filter find available books
State tracking logic to manage borrowing and return transactions
Interactive command line control flow utilizing structured switch navigation modules
challenges: Designing an in-memory data pipeline using efficient Java Collections structures to maintain runtime data integrity without a relational database.

title: Horizon
overview: An asynchronous TypeScript and Angular engine designed to efficiently parse, structure, and render payload streams from OpenWeather RESTful API.
description: An asynchronous TypeScript and Angular engine designed to efficiently parse, structure, and render payload streams from OpenWeather RESTful API.
features: Engineered an asynchronous data-parsing logic block consuming OpenWeather API configurations
Constructed isolated layout components mapping localized daily, hourly, and weekly weather metrics
